name: caldav
description: dominik1001/caldav-mcp: a plain CalDAV client (Radicale, Nextcloud, Fastmail, iCloud). No free/busy tool — the provider computes candidate slots from the events list-events returns. stdio-supervised; basic auth via CALDAV_USERNAME/CALDAV_PASSWORD in the child's environment.
caveats: Needs a per-install collection URL: set integration.<slug>.calendar_url in Settings, which the recipe reads as $cfg.calendar_url. Every tool here requires it and the server has no default.

list-events returns full events — summary, description, location — not opaque busy blocks. The provider never emits them: only computed candidate slots leave it (SPEC §6.7). Exposing list-events UNMAPPED would publish the calendar's contents to a contact.
create-event answers with the event's uid as plain text, not JSON.
